caption: The video captures a dancer seen from behind in a mirrored studio. She already holds both arms straight overhead in a white tank and loose pink pants, her front view tracked by the reflection at the left. For the first moments she stands on both feet. Then one knee bends and the foot lifts into a retiré tucked behind the standing leg, the mirror showing that leg extended back. She rises onto the ball of the standing foot in a relevé, heel clear of the floor, arms still vertical. Her torso and hips rotate so more of her right side comes into view, the arms reshaping from a straight reach into a curved overhead pose and the tucked foot sliding toward the front of the knee. The working leg lowers outward into a wide stance as the turn deepens, arms sweeping down to a mid-level curve. She settles into a broader two-foot stance angled toward the mirror, arms opening and descending to the sides, the reflection following each shift. The curtains, barre and fans shift rightward early on, then hold, a slow camera pan accompanying her turn.
